source.note: Starter means first team on ESPN’s current or earlier weekly depth chart. This retains a ruled-out starter after ESPN moves the replacement above him. ESPN is unofficial; verify final inactives before kickoff.

injuries.name: Charvarius Ward
injuries.detail: Ward is dealing with groin tightness after Sunday night's 33-30 overtime loss to the Chiefs, Jake Arthur of Roundtable.io reports.

injuries.name: Dalvin Tomlinson
injuries.detail: Tomlinson is in line to miss time after sustaining a hamstring injury during Sunday's game versus the Raiders, Noah Furtado of The Athletic reports.

injuries.name: Kayode Awosika
injuries.detail: Awosika is expected to miss time after injuring his fibula during Sunday's game versus the Raiders, Noah Furtado of The Athletic reports.

injuries.name: Zach Wood

injuries.detail: out

injuries.name: Dallas Goedert
injuries.detail: Goedert (knee) was diagnosed Monday with a sprained MCL and is expected to miss a few weeks, Ian Rapoport and Adam Schefter of ESPN report.

injuries.name: Saquon Barkley
injuries.detail: The Eagles announced that Barkley (neck/shoulder) is questionable to return to Sunday's game against the Titans due to a stinger.

injuries.name: Joey Porter Jr.
injuries.detail: Porter will be evaluated Wednesday for a back injury he aggravated during practice last week, Alan Saunders of SteelersNow.com reports.

injuries.name: Michael Pittman Jr.
injuries.detail: Steelers head coach Mike McCarthy said Monday that Pittman's foot injury is not related to the one he dealt with during training camp and the preseason, Nick Farabaugh of PennLive.com reports.

injuries.name: Demarcus Robinson

injuries.name: Mike Evans
injuries.detail: San Francisco head coach Kyle Shanahan said that Evans (hip) will "have to be managed this week" leading up to Sunday's game against the Cardinals, Nick Wagoner of ESPN.com reports.

injuries.name: Anthony Bradford
injuries.detail: out

injuries.name: Sam Darnold
injuries.detail: Darnold (glute) is ahead of schedule in his recovery and has a chance to practice ahead of Seattle's Week 3 road game against the Commanders, head coach Mike Macdonald said after Sunday's 31-7 victory over the Cardinals, Curtis Crabtree of Fox 13 Seattle reports.

injuries.name: Ty Okada

injuries.detail: Coach Mike Macdonald said Monday that Price suffered a shoulder injury during Sunday's win at Arizona, but "it's intact and nothing serious, it seems like," Brady Henderson of ESPN.com reports.

injuries.name: Javon Kinlaw
injuries.detail: Head coach Dan Quinn told reporters Monday that Kinlaw will have an MRI for a shoulder injury, JP Finlay of NBC Sports Washington reports.

injuries.name: Brandon Coleman

injuries.name: Sam Cosmi
injuries.detail: Cosmi suffered a concussion in Sunday's 37-20 loss to the Commanders, Nicki Jhabvala of The Athletic reports.

injuries.name: Nick Cross
injuries.detail: Cross (undisclosed) stayed in Dallas overnight Sunday due to an internal injury, and his status for Week 3 against the Seahawks is up in the air, Ben Standig of Big 100 Washington D.C. reports.
